title: Exception routing & annotation journal
content:
Purpose: quick-running personal log of weird cases that need routing rules or a new adjudication flow. Use this as a scratchpad for short-run heuristics and triage notes before we formalize in the Confluence doc.

High-level problem: edge examples are leaking into training and evaluation sets and causing regression alerts; many are not simple label disagreements but require routing to special processors (OCR fixes, PII redaction, multilingual normalization). Current pipeline: initial pass -> automated heuristics -> human label queue. We need to add an "exception routing" step that classifies a sample into: standard-label, needs-cleanup, needs-adjudication, needs-ocr-repair, needs-redaction, needs-lingual-normalization.

Quick decision tree (first-pass adopter rules):
1) If text contains 2+ distinct languages (script detection) -> route to needs-lingual-normalization.
2) If high punctuation garble and >30% non-alphanumeric after tokenization -> needs-ocr-repair.
3) If digit sequences matching account/SSN/CC heuristics and context includes financial verbs -> needs-redaction.
4) If overlapping spans with identical entity class candidates -> route to needs-adjudication.
5) If short text (<=6 tokens) and label confidence <0.4 -> sample for pair-adjudication.

Sample anomalies collected (raw examples):
- "Acct#: 123-45-6789 (call back)" -> contains possible SSN, route: needs-redaction, candidate redaction tokenization: contiguous digits plus hyphen.
- "l0rem ipsum — cllctn" -> OCR-like: heavy punctuation substitution, route: needs-ocr-repair.
- "Meet with 李 and Anna" -> mixed scripts, route: needs-lingual-normalization; note: do not split named entity spans across scripts unless human confirms.
- "Invoice 9876543210/INV-987" -> numeric + slash tokenizing ambiguous invoice id vs order id; route: needs-cleanup if label is ORDER_ID, else standard-label.

Heuristic sketches (for pipeline implementation):
- OCR-repair: simple character substitution map (0 -> o, 1 -> l/i depending on case, m/rn heuristics) + hyphen join for broken tokens >0.7 probability. Keep conservative to avoid false merges.
- PII detector: two-tier regex + contextual verb list. Regex picks candidates, context score reduces false positives. Redaction policy: mask but store candidate token in audit log for downstream review.
- Overlap resolver: if spans overlap and model confidence delta <0.15 then route to adjudication; else pick higher-confidence span but attach note.

Sampling plan for adjudication batches:
- 50% overlapping-span examples (priority)
- 25% OCR-type low-token-coherence examples
- 15% PII ambiguous cases where context != clear financial action
- 10% misc multilingual tokenization failures

Reviewer checklist (for pair adjudicators):
- Recreate tokenization with our current tokenizer (link in Confluence).
- Check raw upstream text (OCR source if available) before editing.
- If redacting, confirm replacement pattern and note plausible false positive risk.
- Write 1-line justification for each change.

Open questions / TODOs:
- How aggressive should OCR repairs be? (Ava: propose conservative defaults, escalate to product if >5% manual revert rate)
- Do we add a new label class for 'probable-instrument-id' to separate from SSN/CC? (Meeting with legal scheduled 2026-03-04).
- Tagging workflow: add boolean 'routed' flag in metadata so downstream metrics can filter these examples.
- Automation thresholds: run A/B on routing thresholds for 2 weeks, compare manual workload and downstream eval drift.

Short-term action items (owners):
- Add small test harness to simulate OCR repairs and measure precision/recall on a seed of 800 examples (owner: Liam, due 2026-03-05).
- Draft minimal Confluence page describing routing labels + examples (owner: Ava, due 2026-03-12).
- Create Linear ticket for pipeline metadata flagging and sample retention (owner: Miguel, ticket linked above).

Notes to self: keep entries compact. Prefer reproducible heuristics over ad-hoc edits. When in doubt route to adjudication. Record decisions in linked confluence page so we can later fold into labeling SDK rules.

Recent edits: 2026-03-10 added invoice/id ambiguity sample and sampling split.

References and quick links:
- Linear: RED-219 (exception routing prototype)
- GH PR: labeling/pull/413 (initial pipeline router code)
- Confluence draft: CONFLUENCE-742-annotation-guidelines (working)

End of log.
